decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core everyday item made with established recipes and production, so it keeps meeting aspirations at low cost and gives no reason for search.
The premium raisin stollen is the award-winning flagship and clearly exceeds aspirations, so the firm keeps it.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range and shows no sign of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The marzipan stollen complements the flagship stollen in the seasonal gift assortment and is cheap to carry alongside it.
The ancient grain bread is presented as the latest master piece, and the slack freed by dropping Product D lets the firm give it more time to prove itself.
